outsourcing capability is a function of the organization’s capability to manage the outsourcing of processes, and that the management of outsourcing is a function of a number of factors including, but not limited to, the type of process being outsourced and the type of relationship between the outsourcing firm and the service provider.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the paper provides an insight into the varied aspects of outsourcing capability that firms should possess in order to successfully manage their outsourcing activities.
outsourcing capability can be defined as the ability of a firm to manage its outsourced processes in a manner that is consistent with the firm's strategic intent.
the framework presented in this paper is the first attempt to develop a comprehensive model for managing outsourcing capability.

outsourcing can be a very powerful tool for organizations, provided it is managed properly.
